policies.title: Residual ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's Government-authenticated live eVisa service accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the eVisa by email/PDF before travel.
conditions: This applies only when the traveller uses the ordinary/regular passport presented for travel. The eVisa service excludes non-regular travel documents; diplomatic, service, emergency, refugee, residence, crew, work and other special-document routes are not covered.

Register, upload the required visitor documents and pay online. The issued eVisa is sent by email and available as a PDF before travel, so it is electronic issuance rather than a visa issued on arrival.

The 154 codes are the exact residual scope assigned by the research queue. It excludes Equatorial Guinea citizenship, the five foreign CEMAC ordinary-passport visa-free rows, every reviewed canonical GQ relationship and other already-supported easier routes.

Passport validity, health, entry-point, carrier and final-admission requirements remain separate. Any immigration stamp or check at arrival does not change the pre-travel electronic issuance category.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea official eVisa service
steps: Register with the regular passport that will be used for travel.
Upload the required visitor documents and pay online.
Receive the issued eVisa by email/PDF before travel and present it for final immigration processing.
